nodes.summary: The noise operator `T_ρ f x = ∑ y, bnt_noiseKernel ρ x y * f y`: for `ρ ∈ [-1, 1]`, the expectation of `f y` where each coordinate of `y` equals that of `x` with probability `(1 + ρ)/2`.

Uniform expectation on the cube equals the finite average

nodes.summary: The expectation of `f` under the uniform measure on `ι → Bool`. This is `𝔼 ω, f ω` (`Finset.expect`).
nodes.title: Uniform expectation on the Boolean cube

nodes.summary: The vector-valued two-point inequality at noise `ρ`, with `q = 1 + ρ²`: for all `n` and `u v : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ`, the average of `‖((1+ρ)/2) u + ((1-ρ)/2) v‖₂²` and `‖((1-ρ)/2) u + ((1+ρ)/2) v‖₂²` is at most `((‖u‖_q^q + ‖v‖_q^q) / 2)^(2/q)`.
nodes.title: Vector-valued two-point hypercontractive inequality

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.label: statement formalized
